_readme: Plain language versions of each release, for the Simple view of the Changelog.
Keyed by commit so they survive `npm run changelog` and are only written once.
kind is one of: new, better, fixed.
A commit with no entry here does not appear in the Simple view at all, which
is how internal work stays out of a customer's changelog.
With ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set, `npm run changelog` drafts missing ones for review.

e9e94d0.title: Addons
e9e94d0.detail:
Ask the Head of Engineering for an automation and it will build one. For example, posting to Slack whenever a task is marked done, or filing a note every morning.

An addon is saved switched off. Under Integrations an administrator sees exactly what it will do and every outside service it could send to, and approves it by name before anything runs. Pause or delete it at any time, and every run is listed so you can see what happened.

An addon can send but never read anything back, and it is never given a key, a file, or anyone's messages.

af3c5d2.title: Your logo in the browser tab
af3c5d2.detail:
The browser tab now shows your company logo from Settings, so a tab belonging to your business is recognisable at a glance and two businesses open at once are told apart.

Without a logo the tab shows your company letters on your company colour, matching the mark in the corner of the panel.

Removing a logo also works properly now. It used to reappear the next time the panel loaded.

1a23338.title: Changelog
1a23338.detail:
This page. Every update to the panel, newest first.

- **Simple** shows what changed and what it means for you.
- **Technical** shows the full engineering detail behind each release.

1fef674.title: Permissions for each person
1fef674.detail:
An administrator can now decide what each colleague gets to use:

- **Which department heads** they work with, or all of them.
- **Which parts of the panel** they see, such as the calendar, the file library or the inbox.

Nobody is restricted by default, so nothing changes until you choose to change it.

bf10c24.title: Signing out takes effect straight away
bf10c24.detail: Removing someone, or signing out on a shared computer, now ends the session **immediately**. It used to stay valid for a while afterwards.

b84c6b9.title: Clearer labels
b84c6b9.detail: Headings and buttons across the panel now say what they are in a couple of words instead of a sentence.

02b2047.title: Library uploads no longer go missing
02b2047.detail: A file added to the Library is now always stored, and you are **told when an upload fails** instead of it disappearing quietly.

8dceb8d.title: Belong to more than one business
8dceb8d.detail: If you work with several businesses on the panel, switch between them from the **account menu** without signing out.

15e88c3.title: Faster files, and larger ones
15e88c3.detail:
Uploads are kept in proper file storage now, so:

- Pages carrying attachments **load quicker**.
- **Bigger documents** are accepted.

4aab530.title: The operator screen no longer flickers
4aab530.detail: Opening the operator panel used to show a refusal for a moment before loading.

c9e9bb4.title: The operator panel opens on Overview
c9e9bb4.detail: It used to open on the wrong tab, and the Reports tab could load into a blank screen.

480f854.title: The Overview leads with what needs attention
480f854.detail: Rather than a wall of numbers, it now starts with anything waiting on a person.

8448b06.title: Conduct review costs about half as much
8448b06.detail: The review sends far less text to do the same job, so it costs about **half as much** to run, and its reports are easier to read at a glance.

ae176a6.title: Conduct review gives consistent answers
ae176a6.detail: The same messages now produce the **same result every time**. If you hit the limit, it tells you exactly how long to wait rather than saying *try again later*.

50d7e39.title: Each business sees its own conduct reports
50d7e39.detail: An administrator can read and act on reports about **their own people**, instead of only the operator being able to.

ac9004c.title: Conduct review runs on your own key
ac9004c.detail: It no longer needs separate setup before it will work.

9a6253b.title: Everything that can be pressed looks like it
9a6253b.detail: Buttons and rows across the panel now respond properly, and your account is reachable from every screen.

e2eeaf4.title: Profiles for each department head
e2eeaf4.detail:
Open a head to read what they are for and what they can do before you ask them anything.

All Hands is now called a **Meeting**.

3d8a1fd.title: A list of past meetings
3d8a1fd.detail: Meetings are kept and listed the way department conversations are, instead of only the most recent one being reachable.

3efb060.title: Choose who is in the room
3efb060.detail: Pick **which heads answer** before you ask a question of the whole company, rather than always asking everybody.

135f383.title: Navigation restored on the conversation list
135f383.detail: Also fixes the bar at the bottom of the screen on a phone.

a7e2cae.title: The tour walks with you
a7e2cae.detail: It now **takes you to each screen** as it describes it, and asks you for nothing.

433fb66.title: A guided start for a new business
433fb66.detail: A short walk through the panel the first time you sign in.

39dbfad.title: Usage and health for the operator
39dbfad.detail: Sign in counts, activity, error rates, and how the nightly work is doing.

8e35280.title: Settings no longer save on every keystroke
8e35280.detail: Typing in Settings was writing to the database letter by letter.

f96f742.title: A head knows when it cannot see your calendar
f96f742.detail: A head used to say it had *no access to your calendar* when it could see a perfectly working one with a free week in it.

f76322e.title: The Health tab appears
f76322e.detail: It existed but could not be reached.

0639f57.title: Pages load much faster
0639f57.detail:
Work the panel could do at the same time was being done one thing after another.

> A warm page load went from about **two seconds** to **under a tenth of one**.

de4118e.title: Sent and seen on messages
de4118e.detail: A message to a colleague now shows whether it **arrived** and whether they have **read it**.

60560b2.title: The conversation list reads like a list
60560b2.detail: Titles, dates and previews instead of a wall of rows.

766a95b.title: Several conversations with each head
766a95b.detail: Start a **new conversation** with a head rather than everything living in one endless thread.

b53666b.title: The heads follow the writing rules
b53666b.detail: House style now actually reaches every head instead of being ignored.

a2f7a7b.title: Better answers from Finance and Legal
a2f7a7b.detail: Both now reason about the whole picture, and a fault that was quietly stopping their guidance arriving is fixed.

eecf457.title: Every head checks its own work
eecf457.detail: Four checks each head runs before answering, drawn from graded example conversations.

eae4a0d.title: Invited colleagues stop being told there is no key
eae4a0d.detail: The panel was reporting the business had no model key to everyone except the person who set it.

2a11503.title: A clear message when you are in no business yet
2a11503.detail: Rather than an empty panel with nothing to press.

05b8913.title: Several stability fixes
05b8913.detail: Two memory leaks, a blank screen after a failed load, and stored files that were never cleaned up.

3149528.title: Two places one business could see another
3149528.detail: Two places where one business could see another, found by an audit of **every query in the product**, and closed.

86d6ef1.title: Your calendar beside your work
86d6ef1.detail: Connect **Google Calendar** and the heads can see what your week actually looks like before advising you on it.

36aa91a.title: Briefings on a schedule
36aa91a.detail: Set a question to repeat **daily, weekly or monthly**, and the answer is waiting when you next sign in.

e92af6f.title: Export a deliverable
e92af6f.detail: Anything a head writes can leave the panel as a **Word document**, **Markdown** or **plain text**.

9e0f63f.title: Faster page loads
9e0f63f.detail: The panel no longer loads every message in the business on every page.

6ab219b.title: A developer API that holds up
6ab219b.detail: Rate limits, scopes and repeat protection for anything built against the panel.

f00f848.title: Conduct review runs nightly on its own
f00f848.detail: It no longer needs anybody to press a button.

6db2edd.title: Model keys are encrypted
6db2edd.detail: A key a business gives the panel is encrypted before it is stored.

792010c.title: A model key never comes back out
792010c.detail: Nothing returns a stored key to a browser, **not even to the administrator who set it**. Two ways it could have are closed.

76f5eec.title: A clearer invitation email
76f5eec.detail: Rewritten so somebody receiving one knows what it is and what to do.

5545d90.title: No more flash of the wrong company name
5545d90.detail: The panel briefly showed a previous business's name while loading.

171b1f9.title: Faster pages with images
171b1f9.detail: Images are no longer read out of the database on every page load.

c94d828.title: See who a client actually is
c94d828.detail: The operator's client list shows real details rather than blank rows.

f19bd18.title: Each business gets its own admin screen
f19bd18.detail: Add colleagues, set roles and manage access **without going through the operator**.

aae6209.title: A save cannot land in the wrong business
aae6209.detail: A security fix in how saved records choose where they belong.

dc42247.title: Reply length capped on every provider
dc42247.detail: It was only capped on one, so a runaway reply could be expensive elsewhere.

38fe019.title: Send feedback from the account menu
38fe019.detail: Tell us what is wrong or missing **without leaving the panel**.

032840d.title: People renamed to Clients
032840d.detail: The two names for the same thing now match everywhere.

5761b15.title: Running a business and running the panel are separate
5761b15.detail: Being an administrator of your own company no longer touches anything belonging to another.

7f422d6.title: More than one business on one panel
7f422d6.detail: Each business has its own data, its own people and its own settings, kept **fully apart** from every other.

7769044.title: The first sign in reaches a workspace
7769044.detail: A brand new installation used to sign you in to nothing.

3d41ec8.title: Invitations by email
3d41ec8.detail: Add somebody and they get an **email with a link**, instead of being told to find the panel themselves.

e6bcc4b.title: A customer's administrator is not an operator
e6bcc4b.detail: Running your own business no longer gives access to anybody else's.

55f13d9.title: The model key belongs to the business
55f13d9.detail: An administrator sets it **once**, and everybody they invite can use the panel **without ever holding the key** themselves.

1593137.title: Eighteen skills, ready to use
1593137.detail: General purpose skills any business can switch on, with a plain description of what each is and is not.

d755c22.title: Field hints describe the field
d755c22.detail: Placeholder text no longer describes somebody else's business.

0197f62.title: Page content lines up with its heading

09147ae.title: Three layouts for the Library
09147ae.detail: Choose how files and documents are listed.

c2ea0c8.title: File pickers work
c2ea0c8.detail: They did nothing at all when pressed.

9a2b6a5.title: Saves no longer revert silently
9a2b6a5.detail: A rejected save used to look as though it had worked and then quietly undo itself.

11fb408.title: Mobile layout fixes
11fb408.detail: Landscape, the meetings screen, and long words running off the side.

da75de9.title: Wiki pages as cards
da75de9.detail: Easier to scan than one long body of text.

82c5743.title: An editable internal wiki
82c5743.detail: Write down how your business works, for whoever joins next.

4e6be70.title: Actions work on OpenAI and Gemini too

82b3930.title: Heads can act, with your approval
82b3930.detail: A head can propose creating a task or saving a decision. **Nothing happens until you approve it.**

320c7dd.title: Company wide notes always reach the heads
320c7dd.detail: They were being dropped when a department had a lot of its own.

e5cbf90.title: A different model per department
e5cbf90.detail: Choose between **Anthropic**, **OpenAI** and **Google** for each head.

820ccb4.title: Messages laid out as a chat
820ccb4.detail: And your branding now reaches the icons.

d37d3fb.title: Less text on every screen
d37d3fb.detail: Cut back to what is actually useful, with setup moved into the account menu.

4ec017c.title: A rebuilt colour scheme
4ec017c.detail: Better contrast throughout, and a finished dashboard and wiki.

245d3fb.title: Tasks
245d3fb.detail: Keep track of outstanding work, and every head can see **what is already on the list** before suggesting more.

2ae63cd.title: Rearrange the sidebar
2ae63cd.detail: Reorder it and hide what you do not use.

0dec428.title: A dashboard
0dec428.detail: Replaces the org chart as the first thing you see.

e5efb68.title: The panel remembers decisions
e5efb68.detail: Record what was decided and what it was measured against, and the heads **reason from it** in later answers.

6a8fba6.title: No more claiming things are missing while loading
6a8fba6.detail: The panel used to say a screen was empty before it had finished loading.

022a658.title: Collapse the sidebar
022a658.detail: And no stale content flashing on reload.

fec7a14.title: A colour for each head
fec7a14.detail: So they can be told apart at a glance.

efe49a6.title: A tighter skill library
efe49a6.detail: Seventy two skills consolidated down to **fifty six**, with the overlap removed.

9c913a5.title: Heads stop listing what they cannot do
9c913a5.detail: Every reply used to end with a disclaimer about what the head could not do.

472991a.title: Colour coded meeting replies
472991a.detail: Eight answers at once are now possible to tell apart.

bea2232.title: Easier to read replies
bea2232.detail: Looser spacing, and tables that lay out as tables.

f6962d4.title: A silent delete and misleading status dots
f6962d4.detail: Also a slow query behind the department list.

7b09781.title: Work together in a project
7b09781.detail: Conversations inside a shared project are **visible to everybody on it**.

2f63f7a.title: Share projects with colleagues
2f63f7a.detail: One copy of each conversation rather than a duplicate per person.

6e2db55.title: Grouped navigation
6e2db55.detail: Five groups instead of eleven separate entries.

bf8f2b8.title: See what each skill costs
bf8f2b8.detail: Each skill now shows **what it costs**, so switching one off is an informed choice.

214fd12.title: Make the panel yours
214fd12.detail: Editable **company mark**, your **own colours**, and a **keyboard shortcut**.

b0e8c10.title: Tell the heads more about you
b0e8c10.detail: Tell the heads **what you know**, **how you like answers**, and **what you are working on**, so their advice fits you.

2329b01.title: A leadership coach
2329b01.detail: A **private** head, for the things you would not put in front of the room.

cb4f028.title: Library files belong to departments
cb4f028.detail: Share a document with the heads that need it rather than with all of them.

714cb20.title: Headings no longer sit flush against the edge

e867085.title: Messages renamed to Inbox
e867085.detail: Messages is now the **Inbox**. Link previews added, and the settings button fixed.

75c29ae.title: The sign in page no longer lists who has access
75c29ae.detail: The sign in page was listing **every address with access**. It no longer does.

13073e8.title: An onboarding page
13073e8.detail: Something to send somebody on their first day.

e3cd52c.title: What replies cost
e3cd52c.detail: The panel now records **what each answer costs**, so spend can be attributed later.

6064962.title: A clearer message when no key is set
6064962.detail: It now says which side is missing one.

a792cd0.title: An administrator can review conversations
a792cd0.detail: Across the accounts in their own business.

6be0012.title: One less line of noise from every head

2e65f54.title: Pictures for department heads
2e65f54.detail: Replaces the emoji, and you can change them.

346718f.title: Message a colleague
346718f.detail: **Direct messages** between colleagues, inside the panel. Also fixes messages vanishing when sent.

57bcc29.title: No empty key field when the server holds one

1a60dfa.title: A hardened deployment
1a60dfa.detail: Security headers and stricter defaults, with **no change to how you sign in**.

9ca031d.title: Projects
9ca031d.detail: Group work that spans **more than one department**.

14880f9.title: Somewhere to keep the API key

c221e1f.title: No more hunting for a workspace id
c221e1f.detail: The panel looks it up for you.

b4e0e49.title: An account page
b4e0e49.detail: Your **name, pronouns, timezone** and what you are working on, plus **personal API keys**.

5085df3.title: Deleting something removes everything with it
5085df3.detail: The panel and the database disagreed about what a delete should take.

147196f.title: Sign in with Google
147196f.detail: **Sign in with Google**, with the model key held on the server rather than in your browser.

e72dd11.title: The Library, with PDFs and Word files
e72dd11.detail: Upload a **PDF** or **Word** document and the heads can read it.

8db1bea.title: Company wide skills and search
8db1bea.detail: Company wide skills, and a **search palette** across everything in the panel.

f6ec389.title: Attach images, and stop billing on disconnect
f6ec389.detail: A **cancelled reply is no longer paid for**. Image attachments added.

dc55329.title: Eterneon
dc55329.detail: The first version of the panel: *a room of department heads you can go and ask*.
